Peter didn't sink because of the storm. 🌊

The wind was contrary the whole night. Peter walked on the water anyway, until “he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.” And “immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him.”

Let the rain slow you down. 🌧️

A Proverbs chapter for today's date, a psalm prayed out loud, ten quiet minutes, one text to someone from church. “Those that seek me early shall find me.” That's a Sunday that resets your whole week.

Which habit are you trying tonight? Comment 1 to 5 👇

Five thousand men on the grass, one lad with five barley loaves and two small fishes. Jesus gave thanks, everyone ate, and the leftovers filled more baskets than they started with. Then he said: “I am the bread of life.”
